name: app-store-connect-release
description: Create a GitHub release when App Store Connect marks an app version ready for distribution.

scripts.build: npm run build:action && npm run build:cli
scripts.check: node --check action/src/index.js && node --check cli/src/index.js && npm run build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log npx wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.jsonc --dry-run --outdir .wrangler-build
